classification: Unmodified pinned upstream nl with original cwd and bounded BRE argument adapter
changes: No edits to upstream uu_nl, numbering, file traversal, input buffering or error handling.
Original nl entry initializes WASI cwd from PWD using the existing family helper.
Original nl_bre adapter reparses with upstream uu_app and normalizes common BRE styles into its byte-regex grammar; backreferences explicitly rejected. No claim of complete GNU BRE parity.

BRE adapter follows the existing original Waffle grep matcher at 19b3a67 in packages/grep/src/matcher.rs, retaining literal/operator and branch anchor rules with an nl-only typed parser. No Bash or native nl execution inside Waffle.
GNU nl is a test oracle only, never a runtime fallback. Diagnostics and help/version text remain uutils.
